question: Should OpenClaw core accept this broad default-off continuation system, including model-callable compaction and trusted cross-session delegate returns, in this PR?
rationale: The code is not already on main and proof is substantial, but the permanent product/security boundary for cross-session trusted context injection and model-controlled continuation needs maintainer intent, not automation.

options.title: Narrow and approve before merge
options.body: Require conflict resolution, the status-row fix, and explicit owner/security approval of the default-off cross-session and compaction boundary before landing this PR.

options.title: Accept broad default-off surface
options.body: Land the full feature after conflicts are resolved, intentionally owning the new config, schema, plugin SDK, and session-state behavior as a core capability.

options.title: Pause for smaller slices
options.body: Close or pause this PR in favor of narrower PRs such as the self-compaction path in #95272 and separate follow-up APIs.

recommendation.title: Narrow and approve before merge
recommendation.body: Require conflict resolution, the status-row fix, and explicit owner/security approval of the default-off cross-session and compaction boundary before landing this PR.
